sql_template:
SELECT
  if(extract(log_attributes['request.pathname'], '^/functions/v1/([^/]+)') IN ('find-campaigns', 'find-characters', 'find-encounters', 'get-sheet-content', 'main'), extract(log_attributes['request.pathname'], '^/functions/v1/([^/]+)'), '__other_functions__') AS route,
  count() AS requests,
  countIf(log_attributes['request.method'] != 'OPTIONS') AS non_options,
  countIf(log_attributes['request.method'] = 'OPTIONS') AS options,
  countIf(extract(log_attributes['request.pathname'], '^/functions/v1/([^/]+)') != '') AS parsed_paths,
  min(timestamp) AS first_seen,
  max(timestamp) AS last_seen
FROM logs
WHERE source = 'function_edge_logs'
  AND timestamp >= toDateTime64('2026-08-29 00:00:00', 3, 'UTC')
  AND timestamp < toDateTime64('2026-08-30 00:00:00', 3, 'UTC')
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY route
limitations: Seven completed UTC days of observed function-edge traffic; this does not establish that dormant or external clients do not exist. The API requires at most 24 hours per query, so seven daily windows were queried with half-open SQL timestamp bounds.
